run_plot_throughput: run plot_throughput to generate a dual-axis throughput graph from a CSV file
run_plot_latency: run plot_latency to generate a latency vs message size graph from a CSV file
build_throughput_graph_tcp: build a throughput graph with TCP link speed y-axis ticks using plot_throughput
build_throughput_graph_inproc: build an INPROC transport throughput graph with PPS and GBPS axes from CSV data
build_latency_graph: build a latency graph plotting message size against latency in microseconds from CSV
